# A replay of the credit step. The system of record already holds the credit under the key that the engine gives the step: the first try applied it
# and the run stopped before it recorded the step. The key is the hash of the run id item-desk-2-r1 and the step name write:credit#1, so it is the same on the replay.
# The read-back sees the applied credit, so the engine skips the write: the credit is not posted again, and the reply still goes out once.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec obeereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

# The credit was read back as applied, so it was not written a second time. The key is the one that the read-back asked for.
grep 'writes/credit-ad2fef2cff3117218ef2db5f14beee56' curl.log
! grep 'POST' curl.log
! exists writes.log

# The case still finished: the reply went out once and is recorded as sent.
grep -count=1 'ann@example.com' mail.out
grep 'We refund 80 EUR for BK-123456' mail.out
exists home/.desk/sent.tsv
exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-desk-2-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=@WORK@/home/.desk/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.desk/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt
-- home/.desk/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/mail/cur/keep --
-- home/.desk/chat/keep --
-- home/.desk/mail/new/m1 --
Message-Id: <m1@mail.test>
From: Ann Smith <ann@example.com>
Subject: Refund BK-123456

Thanks, Ann Smith. Please refund 80 for BK-123456.
-- resp/_bookings_BK-123456 --
{"ref":"BK-123456","status":"cancelled","paid":120,"currency":"EUR","date":"2026-12-01","customer_name":"Ann Smith","customer_email":"ann@example.com","refunded":0}
-- resp/_eligibility_refund --
{"eligible":true}
-- resp/_writes_credit-ad2fef2cff3117218ef2db5f14beee56 --
{"status":"applied"}
